statement: No relationship may cross a workspace boundary
enforcement: tenant-safe composite FKs on every tenant relation plus RLS defense in depth

statement: A contract cannot use another workspace's own party and its own party must carry an own-legal-entity profile
enforcement: composite FK workspace_id+own_party_id plus own_legal_entity_profiles existence check in serialized command
test_evidence: contract creation negative tests with foreign and non-own parties

statement: A package cannot contain another contract's content
enforcement: full-chain composite FKs workspace->project->contract->package->version on lines segments sources evidence

statement: Child claim segments are non-overlapping and reconcile exactly to the parent quantity
enforcement: single-transaction partition with parent lock plus sum-reconciliation check before commit
test_evidence: partition property tests incl repeated partitions

statement: Progress quantity cannot be overclaimed across active package lineage
enforcement: signed allocation ledger plus locked allocation head proving 0 <= reserved <= effective
test_evidence: concurrent allocation and adjustment race tests

statement: Multi-approver decisions aggregate unambiguously and reviewer order cannot change the result
enforcement: immutable decision-coverage facts propagated at partition under shared lineage head lock

statement: External decision submit is idempotent
enforcement: bounded idempotency key plus request hash with same-receipt replay

statement: A prior acceptance never becomes a new-version decision; the original decision remains the source
enforcement: prior_acceptance_references point at original decision; no decision-row copy path exists

statement: Revoked expired or replaced grants cannot decide
enforcement: grant state expiry revocation version and review epoch rechecked at decision commit under lock

statement: Email prefetch or ordinary GET never consumes or activates the bearer token
enforcement: fragment-only delivery plus deliberate POST exchange; GET handlers perform no grant mutation
test_evidence: prefetch simulation and GET non-consumption tests

statement: Rounded child parts reconcile to line totals
enforcement: largest-remainder allocation from parent minor units with reconciliation assertions

statement: Project currencies are never silently combined
enforcement: per-currency grouping in projections; no implicit FX conversion path

statement: Upload failure does not delete the mobile original
enforcement: local cleanup requires persisted available receipt with matching hash

statement: An ordinary app restart does not lose a pending online capture
enforcement: encrypted persisted pending state and retry metadata

statement: Published or frozen versions cannot be mutated or deleted
enforcement: no UPDATE/DELETE grants plus mutation-rejecting triggers plus successor-only correction

statement: Import never executes formulas macros or dangerous archives
enforcement: inert-text formula capture; archive/parser resource limits; fail-closed validation

statement: At least one active owner remains in every workspace
enforcement: serialized owner-count check under membership lock with expected version

statement: First-owner bootstrap is serialized; workspace plus exactly one initial owner or no result
enforcement: bootstrap key lock plus membership uniqueness in one transaction

statement: Project creation atomically creates explicit project-admin access for its creator
enforcement: same-transaction project plus access grant insert

statement: Own legal profiles require stronger permission than ordinary party edits
enforcement: capability check own_legal_profiles.manage distinct from parties.manage

statement: Responsibility never grants access and project access never implies a responsibility
enforcement: separate project_access_grants and project_responsibility_assignments evaluated independently

statement: Normalized contract number is unique within workspace and own party
enforcement: unique (workspace_id own_party_id normalized_contract_no)

statement: An adjustment references exactly one non-adjustment root in the same workspace assignment and work item and adjustments never chain
enforcement: composite self-FK plus entry_kind check plus root-is-root validation

statement: Effective root and assignment/work-item quantity can never become negative
enforcement: serialized adjustment command proving new effective >= 0 under allocation head lock

statement: 0 <= reserved_quantity <= effective_progress_quantity at every commit
enforcement: allocation head balance check inside every affecting transaction

statement: Accepted reservations cannot be reduced or released in v0.1
enforcement: command surface excludes accepted release; corrected-successor releases only unaccepted scope

statement: Exactly one current package version exists per package series/scope
enforcement: unique package_scope_heads row plus serialized head-advance transaction
test_evidence: head advance and double-freeze race tests

statement: At most one terminal decision exists per complete target tuple
enforcement: tenant-safe unique constraints on quantity tuple and evidence tuple

statement: A same-requirement decision cannot overlap an ancestor or descendant segment already terminally decided
enforcement: overlap check against decision coverage under lineage head lock

statement: Prior acceptance is requirement-specific tenant-safe and unchanged-scope only
enforcement: composite FKs to original chain plus approval_scope_hash and lineage/allocation match validation

statement: An observer cannot submit a decision
enforcement: requirement kind check at decision commit

statement: Evidence decisions never alter quantity or money automatically
enforcement: separate decision tables; no quantity mutation path from evidence outcome; compliance exception instead

statement: A package line is acceptance-homogeneous
enforcement: line uniqueness on work-item version location price currency tax basis; compiler splits otherwise

statement: Freeze requires every claim segment covered by at least one required quantity approval requirement
enforcement: freeze validation before snapshot commit

statement: Internal-review and requirement-exception successor lineages cannot fork
enforcement: unique predecessor constraints plus serialized heads with expected version

statement: A review target set is immutable after first use and has one normalized identity per exact item set
enforcement: deterministic item-set hash unique per occurrence plus no-mutation trigger

statement: Every monetary row satisfies gross = net + tax and components are allocated coupled never independently
enforcement: check constraints on all monetary rows plus coupled allocation algorithm

statement: Missing price and zero price are distinct; missing is unvalued and excluded from numeric VaR
enforcement: price_state enum plus projection rules; UI never shows 0 for missing

statement: Over-contract performance is never silently valued at the contract rate
enforcement: over-contract quantity reported separately as unapproved_unvalued_exposure

statement: Every effective in-scope exposure slice belongs to exactly one workflow state
enforcement: disjoint precedence evaluation; unclassifiable scope is a projection error not an omission

statement: No decision can commit under a superseded package review epoch
enforcement: epoch check at decision commit while holding review head lock

statement: No asynchronous side effect starts before its authorizing transaction commits
enforcement: outbox rows written in the same commit; workers never called inside the transaction
test_evidence: rollback leaves no outbox work test

statement: Audit is append-only with database-enforced actor/target/workspace consistency
enforcement: no UPDATE/DELETE grants plus append-only trigger plus actor chain FKs
test_evidence: audit mutation and mismatch denial tests

statement: The raw bearer token is never persisted; only a keyed HMAC verifier is stored and delivery is one-time post-commit
enforcement: token held in memory for one provider request; revoke-and-reissue on ambiguity

statement: Storage keys and content hashes are immutable and never overwritten
enforcement: no upsert grants; new key per derivative correction or rerender

statement: Staged integrity-only scan-pending blocked and orphaned bytes are never package-visible
enforcement: upload state machine gates availability; package generation reads only available evidence

statement: Upload finalization rechecks authorization and orphaned staging is purged within 24 hours
enforcement: finalization recheck plus idempotent purge job with alerting

statement: The same idempotency key with a different request hash fails; same key and request returns the same durable result
enforcement: unique key tuple plus request hash comparison

statement: Duplicate outbox delivery creates one effective job/effect
enforcement: unique (consumer outbox_event effect_kind) receipt

statement: Only the current lease/fence holder may finalize a job attempt
enforcement: monotonic fence check at finalization

statement: Projection replay at one watermark is deterministic and older results cannot overwrite newer
enforcement: watermark plus algorithm version guard on projection writes

statement: Unknown capability values deny and UI presets are never authorization truth
enforcement: closed capability identifiers evaluated server-side

statement: Pending mobile originals are envelope-encrypted and inaccessible to another identity; logout/revocation quarantines rather than deletes
enforcement: per-file key wrapped by Keychain/Keystore-bound key; quarantine state machine

statement: A source amount discrepancy outside pinned tolerance blocks publication until explicit resolution
enforcement: publication validation plus source_amount_resolutions fact requirement

statement: Exposure slices allocate from the work-item valuation pool minor units; the same quantity is never independently rounded twice
enforcement: append-only valuation allocation lineage from pool amounts

statement: A grant/session is bound to one exact package version and scope and fails closed on any mismatch
enforcement: composite FK to exact version plus scope check at every request

statement: Token exchange is single-use and atomic; one concurrent winner; replays receive a generic invalid-link response
enforcement: grant lock plus consumed-at marker in one transaction

statement: State-changing external endpoints require synchronizer CSRF token and origin validation; SameSite is not the defense
enforcement: session-bound CSRF token plus origin/content-type checks

statement: Signed URLs are short-lived single-object never stored and never allow listing
enforcement: 60s TTL default plus BFF authorization before issue plus proxy path for revocable data
test_evidence: signed URL expiry and listing denial tests

statement: Future object privileges are deny-by-default and every exposed tenant relation has RLS
enforcement: alter default privileges revocation plus RLS coverage CI check
test_evidence: default privilege and RLS coverage tests
